scope: Bounded deterministic delivery adapter over the unchanged ContentBridge. The same realized output, sender/receiver authority, facet cap and native paid receipt rules apply to self mediation and interpersonal uptake. This transport checkpoint does not claim autonomous demand-to-social-route selection, social retention or collective competence.

parent_split.FT7.1a: Ordered native content packets, partial paid uptake, withdrawal/missing uptake controls and exact restart
parent_split.FT7.1b: Autonomous owned demand and support choice linked to the paid packet, actual downstream consumer and scoped closure/retention under selected load-v1/success-v1 policies
parent_split.FT7.1_gate: Same native demand, packet, paid operation and capability rules inside/between agents; actual participant contribution and later use. FT7.1a alone does not accept this parent gate.

state.ownership: Native engine owns objects, participant access, wallet, task operations and immutable history; ContentBridge owns exact emitted packets and paid uptake receipts; new adapter owns only integer turn, sender sequence, due queue, delivery status and deterministic trace.
state.limits: One declared one- or two-participant channel, at most eight emitted packets. No global four-member native commitment. Participants are exact ObjectId identities already present in native profiles.
state.due_rule: Emission at turn t queues the realized output for t+1. Advance integer turn once per step. Ready deliveries order by (due turn, canonical sender identity, sender emission sequence, canonical receiver identity, packet key). Queue construction or map insertion order cannot affect this total order.
state.availability: Each step accepts only the current channel participants who are available. Missing receiver availability suspends delivery with pending content preserved; it supplies no permission, debit, output or receipt. Missing uptake through the bounded horizon remains pending, never accepted knowledge.
state.partial_work: ContentBridge.receive executes the unchanged native read with a positive integer work limit. Incomplete paid work remains partial and grants no kept content. Duplicate emission is rejected. Completed delivery never repeats uptake, charge or payment.
state.checkpoint: Exact typed native hash plus bridge events/packets/receipts/kept/charge and adapter queue/events/counters. Restore must validate paired native hash, exact key domain and total event indices. Restart during partial paid read must be equivalent to uninterrupted continuation.
state.relations: Packet aspect remains the actual sender operation output. Receiver seat is independently reconstructed from unchanged TIM and aspect. The intertype landing map is a geometry check, never a skill, permission or completion rule.

fixed_panel.fixture: Existing tests_c3 setup_c3 and tests_c7_workflow setup_workflow. Peer source is the accepted public-packet fixture from tests_ft2: canonical Commune expenditure via cell_c2; workflow Share expenditure via cell. Self uses the same realized public output, with the exact native sender receipt. Input routes are evaluator fixtures, never relabeled as autonomous choice.
fixed_panel.denominators: Four primary supplied-output transport witnesses, four availability/uptake controls, two partial-read restart witnesses and one two-packet queue permutation witness. Preserve all failures and incomplete observations. No all-TIM coverage is claimed by this sub-batch.

gate: Fourteen exact methods pass with zero failures/errors under an unchanged prospective source freeze, independent auditor reconstructs four primary and four controls from native journals and bridge receipts, two partial restart comparisons are exact, stable delivery order survives queue insertion permutation, all 267 predecessor identities remain exact, and no new native capability or participant authority is minted. Passing accepts only FT7.1a transport; FT7.1b and parent FT7 remain pending.
boundary: No altered baseline, TIM, dimensionality, released defaults, native law, permanent H.retained, certificate scope or theoretical C/D/subtype election. Selected conditioning/reserve policies are carried forward as engineering hypotheses; this adapter does not itself supply their causal social integration.
